sentences.text: Heard Shri. M. P. Singh Gaur, learned A.G.A.
It appears from order sheet that on 13.07.2018 and 03.07.2019, there was a direction for giving delay condonation application.
So far, no such delay condonation application has been given.

By the impugned judgement passed by the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Orai in Case No. 2333 of 1994 (State Vs. Santosh Kumar) under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act., Police Station Jalaun, District Jalaun.

entities.text: Case No. 2333 of 1994 (State Vs. Santosh Kumar)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accused was acquitted from the said charge.

From the perusal of the judgement, it appears that no evidence was given from the prosecution side and more over even though application was given by the accused for sending the sample for chemical examination, which is the right of the accused under the said Act, the same was not done.
In view of above facts and also keeping in view that there is no delay condonation application, the leave application is rejected and accordingly the appeal is dismissed.
